decision.reason: A safe repeat execution requires all target request-page parameters. FA-253 proved only Document No.; the other parameters were visible as labels but not field-safe controls.

rootCause.summary: Business Central request pages can render labels, filters and inputs as separate DOM/control objects. The accessible name based textbox probe is too narrow for this request page.

Rows/text contained Depreciation Book, Posting Date and Filter: Fixed Asset labels.
The target fields were not located through getByRole('textbox', { name: ... }).
